title: PAH-OMC-001 closes finite common dynamics and exposes the first refinement obstruction
question: Can a separately versioned PAH owner morphism contract close exact finite common dynamics without editing PAH-001, and does the source-minimal free-vertex pullback provide the required nontrivial refinement intertwining?
decision_reason: PAH-OMC-001 supplies the exact missing move, inverse, invalid, duplicate, symmetry-action, root-measure, multiplicity and finite-domain definitions. Their exact audit proves projection-generator commutation and B^*B=-L on the composite model's finite invariant core, so Stage 1 advances. The named natural free-vertex restriction does not intertwine generators because an added positive-kappa_s edge makes the fine aperture rate vary inside one coarse fibre. That route is retired, but other owner-chosen morphisms remain open; therefore the overall programme is held at Stage 2 rather than promoted or globally refuted.
method: Preserve PAH-001 byte-for-byte and create one separately versioned researcher-owned completion with an independently pinned hash.
Define PH, TR, LK and AP as inverse-closed partial coordinate maps with exact invalid, parallel-edge, K=2 duplicate and zero-radius conventions.
Define gauge and anchor-automorphism actions on state and root labels, including orientation signs, and prove move, mobility, energy and rate equivariance.
Define D_rho, the pi-weighted directed-root Hilbert space, exact multiplicity, full finite domains and the sqrt(c/2) incidence map, then prove the Dirichlet identity.
Enumerate a complete 768-state anchored fixture, reconstruct the proof independently with modular identities and conductance matrices, reject 41 hostile mutations, and compile a Lean cross-check.
Test the named free-vertex restriction refinement and factor its within-fibre aperture-rate difference exactly before considering any uniform estimate.
finding: For the composite PAH-001 plus PAH-OMC-001 model, exact inverse closure, symmetry equivariance, [P_cand,L_rho]=0 and B_rho^*B_rho=-L_rho all pass on A_rho^inv=range(P_cand). Primary 81/81, independent 191/191, hostile 42/42 with all 41 mutations rejected, integrated 46/46 and Lean R479 pass with digest c6f2e8ac2d62de0b99c35a4947003d2ede24d3b61f4f03bcee73b9a975e4a64e. Stage 1 is MAINLINE_ADVANCE. The free-vertex pullback refinement fails exact intertwining because D_z(z_1)-D_z(z_2)=-kappa_s delta(z_1-z_2) is nonzero under its preregistered assumptions. No alternative owner morphism is selected, so the programme remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE_AT_STAGE_2.
decision_scope: T5 finite exact theorem for a hash-pinned composite T0 candidate on finite connected oriented bounded-degree relational two-cell complexes, finite Z_K, fixed Q, finite local cutoffs, unchanged F_rho, unchanged nu, counting-measure Gibbs normalization and external stochastic Markov time. No limit is taken. The refinement negative is limited to a free fine vertex, natural forgetful coarse map, unchanged positive kappa_s and exact pullback intertwining.
evidence_level: T5 finite exact composite-model theorem with primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean verification; route-local exact refinement negative
boundary: The theorem is not retroactive evidence about PAH-001 alone. It admits no nontrivial refinement, uniform estimate, continuum, physical projection or observable chain. Markov time is not quantum, proper or Lorentzian time. No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, event-horizon, area-law, Lorentz, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
assumptions: PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001 are used only at their pinned raw-byte hashes.
The PAH-OMC integer phase label remains a counting-measure state coordinate at zero radius.
Every retained root label, including coincident K=2 and parallel-edge channels, is counted exactly once in L_rho and K_rho.
The finite symmetry group acts by the displayed root relabelling and orientation sign.
The refinement counterexample has 0<epsilon<1, nonzero aperture step, positive kappa_s, and two distinct fine aperture values in one coarse fibre.
missing_assumptions: One owner-selected nontrivial anchor-preserving cell-subdivision functor.
One coarse-state map or observable embedding for fluctuating fine fields.
Parameter and cell-weight transport for Q, cutoffs, a, beta, nu and theta.
A compatible move/root morphism or lumping kernel.
Either exact generator intertwining or one preregistered uniform boundary-defect estimate in regulator, volume, shape, source, phase and exhaustion.
non_claims: No theorem is retroactively attributed to PAH-001 alone.
No nontrivial refinement, uniform limit, continuum, physical projection, F_lim, F_eff or F_obs is admitted.
No Markov time is identified with quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, event horizon, area law, Lorentz symmetry, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass gap, cosmic origin or TOE conclusion follows.
The free-vertex negative result is route-local and not a global no-go.
